decision: Reject the budget-sized final-pool trials. Retain count-sized native allocation; the 48-MiB early-reclamation trial has flat low-memory view time and exceeds the load budget. No trial source retained.
scope: Modern Green 2/map16, translated authored strokes, 1728x1024 terrain at 2048,2300. Sequential alternating pairs, fresh-server warmups discarded, quiet GPU starts. One release sample per run.

variants.reuse-priority: 48-MiB pool reclaimed before useful cached inputs, 512 MiB
